gaps.sentence: She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: ___ of my parents speaks French, so I translate for them.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of' = not one and not the other (two people).

gaps.sentence: The museum charges for entry; ___, under-twenties visit free.
gaps.explanation: 'However' marks the contrast between paying and free.

gaps.sentence: There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).

gaps.sentence: She denied ___ the last piece of cake.
The soup tastes ___ — did you use fresh herbs?
The committee meets ___ other month, always on a Tuesday.
gaps.explanation: 'Every other month' = one month yes, one month no.
